related_questions.snippet: Common side effects include pain at the injection site, fever, body aches and headaches. However, it is possible that a booster may be recommended in the future, especially for high-risk individuals or those who have received their last vaccination dose more than a year ago.

It is important to stay up-to-date with the latest recommendations from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) regarding COVID-19 vaccination. You can find the most current information on the CDC website.
